trials.intent: A task dependency names a previously completed task index; reject a dependency at or beyond the number of completed tasks.
Success requires one additional attempt after all planned failures; reject when failures consume the entire attempt budget.
Stop a workflow before an approval-required task if human approval is absent; approved tasks may proceed if dependencies and retries permit.
